claim_text: A retrospective harm–benefit analysis of preclinical research found that, weighing the animals' actual harms against the actual clinical benefit their studies produced, fewer than 7% of the studies examined would have been ethically permissible, and that 97% did not even report whether the animals received analgesia.
normalized_claim: a retrospective harm benefit analysis of preclinical research found that weighing the animals actual harms against the actual clinical benefit their studies produced fewer than 7 of the studies examined would have been ethically permissible and that 97 did not even report whether the animals received analgesia

claim_atoms.text: A retrospective harm–benefit analysis of preclinical research found that, weighing the animals' actual harms against the actual clinical benefit their studies produced, fewer than 7% of the studies examined would have been ethically permissible, and that 97% did not even report whether the animals received analgesia.

claim_scope.biological: preclinical animal research harms and analgesia reporting
claim_scope.clinical: clinical benefit derived from preclinical studies

passages.text: Only the moderate bisphosphonate studies, less than 7% of the total, appeared to minimise harms to animals whilst being associated with benefit for humans.

citation_contexts.independence_basis: Conservative single-group assignment from the legacy robustness assessment (1 independent citation(s); replication status ['replicated']; documented independent replication; effect size reported.).

traceability.rationale: Every supporting citation has verified passage attribution and eligible citations cover every claim atom. Legacy assessment: 1/1 citations carry a verbatim supporting passage (full text); DOIs present for 1/1.
traceability.recommended_fix: Attach a verbatim supporting passage and a resolvable DOI to every citation.

robustness.rationale: Every atom is covered, but the evidence resolves to one independence group. Legacy assessment: 1 independent citation(s); replication status ['replicated']; documented independent replication; effect size reported.
failure_modes: Every atom is covered, but the evidence resolves to one independence group.
robustness.recommended_fix: Add genuinely independent evidence for each atom, documenting shared authors, datasets, laboratories, and cohorts.

uncertainty_calibration.rationale: The surface wording matches direct eligible support. Legacy assessment: The finding is explicitly attributed to a single retrospective harm-benefit analysis and reported as that study's result, matching a replicated, non-conflicted source.
uncertainty_calibration.recommended_fix: No change; wording correctly localises the figures to the cited analysis.

source_integrity.rationale: Every relied-upon source is primary, DOI-linked, registry-checked, direction-matched, and passage-verified. Legacy assessment: CrossRef re-resolution: {'VERIFIED': 1}; 1/1 full-text-checked; bibliographically consistent.
source_integrity.recommended_fix: Prefer peer-reviewed primary sources; keep DOIs CrossRef-consistent.

transferability_scope_control.rationale: The recorded evidence scope matches the claim. Legacy assessment: Claim stays within the source's preclinical-animal-studies scope and does not generalise beyond the analysed drug classes.
